answer.reason: The verses state what was written on the cross and that Pilate wrote it and refused to change it, which are the chief things the object is known for.

clauses.english: was written by Pilate and put on the cross over Jesus: the King of the Jews
clauses.quote: And Pilate wrote a title, and put it on the cross.

clauses.english: was written in Hebrew, Greek and Latin, and read by many of the Jews
clauses.quote: it was written in Hebrew, and Greek, and Latin.

clauses.english: was kept as written when Pilate refused the chief priests' request to change it
clauses.quote: What I have written I have written.

doubts: The Matthew and Mark verses give differing wordings of the inscription; only the John wording is used for the first clause.
